experiment.goal: Preserve the current native-English OpenGlass conversation while moving deterministic perception to the local HTP.
experiment.claim_boundary: The physical Kalama board, QAIRT 2.36 and one YOLO HTP context have been verified. The complete English camera-to-speech workflow, MiniCPM on HTP, power and sustained thermal behavior remain pending.

runtime.platform_validator: DSP prerequisites present; hardware supported; libraries found; Hexagon Architecture V73
runtime.fast_rpc_version: unavailable: platform validator reports the query is not implemented

htp_evidence: QNN accelerator execute timing and per-op HTP cycles reported
qnn_smoke.measurement_scope: graph execution microbenchmark with qnn-net-run; not camera preprocessing, NMS, tracking or speech

physical_board_evidence.access_note: The debug BSP required root adbd for unsigned HTP protection-domain access. Non-root qnn-net-run failed before graph execution.
physical_board_evidence.usb_note: USB transport detached after adb root; reconnect is required before the next deployment stage.

Qualcomm AI Hub YOLOv11-Detection checkpoint YOLO11-N, 640x640, W8A16 QNN context binary
minimum_runnable_stack.license_gate: Ultralytics AGPL-3.0 or commercial license review required before distribution

Qualcomm AI Hub Depth-Anything-V2 Small, 518x518, W8A16 QNN context binary

minimum_runnable_stack.safety_boundary: Relative/coarse depth only until camera-specific metric calibration passes.

minimum_runnable_stack.implementation: Existing MiniCPM-o 4.5 native English audio/vision/Talker workflow
minimum_runnable_stack.freshness_policy: Send the newest timestamped frame or ROI only; surface frame age and network state.

english_asr.candidate: QAI AppBuilder Whisper Tiny English encoder/decoder
english_asr.placement: QNN HTP with CPU autoregressive control
english_asr.baseline: Keep native MiniCPM-o English audio on H100 for the first physical experiment.

local_vlm_control.candidate: BYOM VLM feasibility experiment; no current Qualcomm AI Hub Qwen-VL card lists QCS8550
local_vlm_control.role: Use installed GenieX Qwen3-0.6B as text-planner control only after placement profiling; keep free-form visual QA on H100.

why_not_baseline: The official deliverable is a GGUF language model plus F16 multimodal projector, not a QNN context binary.
The Snapdragon Hexagon backend can expose HTP devices but does not prove that every MiniCPM-V 4.6 language and projector operator stays on HTP.
The original llama-omni-server is hard-wired to split MiniCPM-o 4.5 vision/audio/TTS modules and cannot host MiniCPM-V 4.6 through its native full-duplex API.
positive_evidence: The 1.61 GB Q4_0 plus projector bundle fits the 16 GB memory class comfortably.
A bounded CUDA profile used about 2.50 GiB incremental GPU memory and 1.16 GiB host RSS, but CUDA is not QNN/HTP proof.
promotion_requirements: Physical llama.cpp Hexagon build lists an HTP device.
A 224-pixel preprocessed frame produces one 64-token visual batch.
Verbose logs prove both language and projector work is placed on HTP with zero silent fallback.
English quality, P50/P95 latency, peak unified memory and 30-minute thermal behavior pass.
